description: Build and sign a crabcrop URL from an operation string and a source. Returns the full URL. Uses CRABCROP_BASE / CRABCROP_SECRET from the environment unless base/secret arguments override them; with no secret the URL carries the literal `unsafe` signature segment. Prefer the environment for the secret: per-call secret arguments are deprecated.

base.description: crabcrop endpoint origin. Defaults to CRABCROP_BASE.

expires.description: Optional unix-seconds expiry, emitted as an exp: segment.

keyId.description: Optional key ID stamped on the signature segment (`<key-id>:<tag>`) for servers running a secret rotation; they verify a keyed segment against the named key only.

operations.description: Operation string, e.g. "crop:1200x630:smart/filters:format(webp)"; may be empty and may contain preset: references.

secret.description: Signing secret. Defaults to CRABCROP_SECRET; omit for unsafe URLs. Sensitive, deprecated: prefer the CRABCROP_SECRET environment variable; a per-call secret is kept in client transcripts.

source.description: Source locator: an http(s) URL, s3://bucket/key, gs://bucket/key, or file:// path.

name: sign_url
